findings.title: ADD used instead of COPY
findings.description: ADD fetches remote URLs and auto-extracts archives, which can pull untrusted content into the image. Prefer COPY for local files.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: chown in RUN instead of COPY --chown
findings.description: Running chown in a separate RUN duplicates every affected file into a new layer, bloating the image. Use COPY --chown to set ownership at copy time.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: No maintainer label
findings.description: Images without ownership metadata are harder to triage when a vulnerability is found. Add LABEL maintainer= or org.opencontainers.image.authors.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: No STOPSIGNAL directive
findings.description: Without STOPSIGNAL the container gets SIGTERM, which apps that only handle SIGINT (or expect another signal) ignore until the orchestrator SIGKILLs them, risking data loss. Declare the signal your app handles for graceful shutdown.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: COPY of entire build context
findings.description: COPY . ships the whole build context into the image, often including credentials, VCS history, and dev tooling. Copy only what the app needs and gate the context with .dockerignore.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: ADD fetches remote URL
findings.description: ADD with a remote URL downloads at build time with no integrity verification, and the layer is never invalidated properly. Use curl/wget with a checksum verification followed by COPY instead.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.
